scope: Local preparation only; not SQL parser or native execution evidence.
review_corrections: Reject views, foreign tables, partitions and inheritance before reads.
Allow only listed builtin column types before whole-row hashing or pinned catalog reader.
Keep original 503 cause and expired-subject association explicitly unproven.
Separate closure from a default-closed one-cycle restart authorization gate.
Never return the ninth Intake overflow sentinel: return a small STOP object before payload output on any bound or required-function failure.
